definitions.CONDITIONAL: Stable base alignment whose OPEN, DANGEROUS, or CLOSED usability changes through bounded world-state records.
definitions.DEFERRED: No path is authored because canon, art, endpoint meaning, or later world/runtime ownership is insufficient.
definitions.DYNAMIC: Traversal geometry is selected, moved, or removed by an owning ecology/system and is never stored as base topology.
definitions.PERMANENT: Stable infrastructure or geography whose identity persists even while hazardous or locally blocked.

playerKnowledge.rule: Knowledge is player/party information with freshness; it never replaces authoritative OPEN/DANGEROUS/CLOSED route state.

policy: World connection is semantic; connection path is stable scene geometry; current gameplay usability belongs to a future authoritative route-state service.

routes.name: Riverlands / Ashline historical corridor
routes.notes: Prompt D preserves the approved local geometry. Permanent means the road identity survives; system-owned condition records may still make a segment dangerous or closed.

routes.name: Drowned Intake / Ocean shallow-draft approach
routes.notes: Prompt D preserves the approved base alignment. Hydrology, Bloomstorms, intake state, and Old Drowner change usability through route-state records, never alternate static paths.

routes.name: Cairnwood Camp / Glassroot Observatory expedition trail
routes.notes: V3 review supports one stable surveyed alignment. Migration, saturation, Bloomstorms, and field disturbance alter cost or close it through future condition records.

routes.name: Southreach reserve/service rail alignment
routes.notes: OTHER is the closest existing taxonomy for mixed rail, service bed, and plant access. Ashline-Southreach and the Redline spur remain represented by the preserved Riverlands corridor, avoiding duplicate geometry.

routes.name: Walking Orchard / Reedless moving corridor
routes.notes: The Orchard moves and the Reedless opening can vanish. Runtime may select from authored corridor envelopes; no canonical line exists.

routes.name: Reedless Mile temporary openings
routes.notes: Bare substrate creates schedule-bound openings, not a stable trail.

routes.name: Long Graze herd corridor
routes.notes: Herd and predator movement creates a temporary travel corridor, never a guaranteed player road.

routes.name: Heartfen access openings
routes.notes: Access is a changing ecological opening or route-less exploration. Heartfen receives no convenient permanent road.

routes.name: Living Marsh secondary waterways
routes.notes: Secondary channels close, redirect, or cease to be navigable. Only the Drowned Intake approach has a stable base alignment.

routes.name: Riverlands world-scene continuation
routes.notes: The V3 world Atlas establishes adjacency and landmass context but does not show a defensible exact road line. The semantic connection and local Ashline path remain sufficient.

routes.name: Ocean world-scene continuation
routes.notes: The V3 world coast does not provide exact shallow-draft continuation geometry. Preserve the semantic connection and local Drowned Intake alignment only.

routes.name: Magic-Torn Wasteland adjacency
routes.notes: Geographic adjacency only. Current Codex contains no semantic travel route, trail, road, or hidden passage.

travelMatrix.aberrants: Occupation changes risk and intel, never topology.
travelMatrix.bloomstorms: Usually usable with exposure/visibility risk; severe footprints can close a segment.
travelMatrix.essenceSaturation: May raise cost and warnings; does not erase the road.
travelMatrix.harvestingPressure: No default effect; only an authored structural consequence may alter a local spur.
travelMatrix.reactorCycles: Southreach/Ashline segments can become dangerous or closed; bed persists.

travelMatrix.aberrants: Old Drowner can make the channel unsafe or impassable without deleting its alignment.
travelMatrix.bloomstorms: Onset/Peak can close shallow water; Decay/Aftermath may create a valuable window.
travelMatrix.essenceSaturation: Contaminated flow raises exposure and spell/equipment risk.
travelMatrix.harvestingPressure: Sink loss can raise water/load and close the approach.
travelMatrix.reactorCycles: Venting, Purge, Overflow, or Breach can send load through the intake.

travelMatrix.aberrants: Bellwether/herd displacement changes safety and confidence, not the surveyed alignment.
travelMatrix.bloomstorms: Warning supports evacuation; Peak may close exposed sections; Aftermath may reward travel.
travelMatrix.essenceSaturation: Active/Surge bands raise warnings, creature density, and traversal cost.
travelMatrix.harvestingPressure: Local root/ground damage can make the surveyed bed dangerous or temporarily closed.
travelMatrix.reactorCycles: Only indirect transferred pressure affects it; a reactor label cannot close it remotely.

travelMatrix.aberrants: Last Shift procedures can open one access while sealing another; route identity persists.
travelMatrix.bloomstorms: Exposed conductors and visibility make Onset/Peak hazardous or closed.
travelMatrix.essenceSaturation: Charge and contamination make fixed segments dangerous.
travelMatrix.harvestingPressure: No generic effect; only removal of functional infrastructure can alter access.
travelMatrix.reactorCycles: Dormant may permit manual access; Restart/Purge may open systems; Venting/Overflow/Breach can close segments.

travelMatrix.aberrants: Bellwether and Old Drowner influence corridor selection through ecology/hydrology.
travelMatrix.bloomstorms: Storm and aftermath can move, expose, or erase current geometry.
travelMatrix.essenceSaturation: Pressure gradients help select or remove a temporary corridor.
travelMatrix.harvestingPressure: Sink/root/herd disruption can move the corridor instead of toggling a fixed line.
